judge_inputs: Inspect the actual service,normal canonical reports,command traces and source-bound evidence. No synthetic observation overlay is supplied. This is a real code-changing instrumentation stage. Implement the current approved/default baseline through the real startup path,run configured project checks and normal verification,and repair failures. The unchanged logging workflow checker must actually pass on the generated app;read-only plans or Not run cannot satisfy implemented runtime coverage.

For positive implementation/verification,inspect raw .observe/logging-workflow-proof evidence,actual stdout/stderr and exact received span/log joins from the unchanged host checker. The independent pipeline also reruns that checker;self-reported success alone is insufficient.

Return exactly one check per criterion with IDs rubric-1 through rubric-14. Keep unselected/unsupported and unexecuted cases honest;do not require optional app features solely because a reference mentions them.

Studio live telemetry is intentionally evicted when the producer exits. The unchanged host checker captures its exact SDK log/span joins and native-count snapshot while the app is alive, then proves bounded owned-process cleanup. Live capture and cleanup do not establish post-exit persistence or final-record SDK drain; those require separate selected receipt evidence. Do not classify expected explorer eviction as missing application wiring.
rubric: Uses the requested loaded skill against the actual service and its current state. Distinguishes source/config/default evidence from executed telemetry;does not use imagined overlay observations or fabricated outcomes. This is a real code-changing instrumentation stage. Implement the current approved/default baseline through the real startup path,run configured project checks and normal verification,and repair failures. The unchanged logging workflow checker must actually pass on the generated app;read-only plans or Not run cannot satisfy implemented runtime coverage. Proof modes are per evidence row: focused SDK/bridge/receiver proof uses a supported focused mode such as unit+otlp; preserve app_test for actual application-test proof, and never upgrade a focused probe to full_runtime because a separate test starts the app. Audit uses proof_level: focused call-site or a justified either for isolated capability fixtures; full runtime requires the normal app/agent startup dependency. Audit keeps all boundaries planned, not executed. Determine scenario AND item proof modes from the actual path, not audit proof_level, package/test filename or suite command: isolated in-memory SDK/bridge proof is unit; decoded loopback SDK export is unit+otlp; an actual application-owned helper/setup test can legitimately be app_test; full_runtime requires the claimed normal application path. Do not map every focused scenario to app_test or every item to full_runtime. Item mode describes its direct assertion scope: actual runtime proof can legitimately coexist with clearly scoped ancillary focused/incomplete scenarios. Do not fail merely because those are attached; fail an unsupported combined claim or mechanical first-scenario mode/visibility that misrepresents the item evidence.

Follows the canonical audit/selection/instrumentation/verification contract. Preserve the immutable audit, bound IDs and source during read-only verification. Audit plans controls without executing them. Reconcile every required trigger AND acceptance assertion, including named input variants, operations, event orders and negative controls; related passes or a zero exit cannot close an omitted assertion. Independently inventory the complete required contract with effective launch/exporter configuration, expected outcome and named assertion/output. Planning before targeted probes is recommended; a later complete contract-derived reconciliation is valid. Judge actual omissions/overclaims rather than chronology alone. Grouped presentation is valid when referenced parameterized cases, tests or assertions/output make each member individually addressable; do not require one physical report row per input. A copied acceptance paragraph or retrospective list of passing tests alone is insufficient. Derive each scenario/item verdict from its required-control results. Unmatched controls stay Not run/Not proven; reject closure inferred only from blanket Working/default-true finalizers or aggregate success, and reject overclaimed individual rows even when the overall result is Partial. A disabled-logs SIGINT test cannot prove enabled-log final drain; same-path conjunctions need joint proof. In the completed audit, separate differing proof boundaries under consistent scenario IDs; an agent-equipped environment does not make constructed bridge/error/cancellation or isolated exporter probes full runtime. The audit either level permits alternative adequate proof of the same contract, not a mixture. A related focused SDK/receiver acceptance test may be attached to an app-wiring finding with explicit upstream owner, capability disposition and proof boundary; do not fail that attachment alone or require an application parser/retry substitute. Unverified upstream capability may retain conditional future checks. Later stages preserve frozen IDs, explain differing observed scopes in existing evidence/observations and retain incomplete required-scope closure as not proven. Never apply one control's strongest proof mode or visibility to a mixed row. Reconcile each item result with its own declared change/name/product_view. A configuration item promising bridge, batch exporter and final drain cannot be Working from opt-out alone while drain is unproven. Derive the actual item claim, required assertions and mode/visibility explicitly, not by selecting a passing scenario based only on item type. Direct item proof may coexist with incomplete related scenario coverage; a related scenario is not automatically an additional required assertion for every item. Judge unsupported claims and omitted assertions from actual evidence, not report-helper syntax alone; a constant result after a complete directly asserted control set is not itself a defect. Trace each selected finding's promised operation/outcome to an addressable scenario trigger and acceptance control. A promise in expected_telemetry is not covered by a related operation alone. Published audit IDs/environments/proof_level must match all constituent paths; the scalar level applies to every trigger/acceptance clause, and prose calling a subcase focused/app_test cannot override that level. Require separate scoped IDs or a valid identical-contract either boundary. Independently reconcile source-clause branches and declared telemetry promises: a required-controls inventory enumerates the latter only. Its success cannot substitute for concrete numeric, enum or other source-branch acceptance, even when complete primary excerpts are retained. Preserve supported SDK-disabled/filter Boolean true/false casing, empty/unset and invalid-value branches as concrete controls, accounting for the actual active configuration owner. Check each consumed setting and owning path, including selected bridge/agent enablement flags separately from SDK-disabled behavior. Require per-setting input/effective-value/fallback/diagnostic outcomes and concrete acceptance; a primitive-type group cannot stand in for different settings. Attribute-literal hints are omission aids only: semantic aliases may be valid and mere field-name mentions do not prove assertions. Preserve conditional supplied Resource metadata with a concrete preservation control rather than inventing absent values. Trace each selected setting from raw input/omission through reader, conversion, precedence/fallback, post-validation/default factory and final consumer. Resolve symbolic sentinel constants to actual values rather than treating their names as serialized literals. Include transitively consumed settings and compound higher-priority absent/empty/invalid plus valid nondefault fallback cases; an intermediate converter result is not the effective outcome. Derive SDK limitations honestly rather than assuming universal standard inheritance. Derive the selected configuration-name inventory independently from source declarations/readers and actual consumption; classify conditionally read or out-of-path names with evidence. Reconcile every consumed name against concrete saved input/effective/error/diagnostic/acceptance cases. A future instruction to enumerate or resolve accessible facts does not complete the handoff. Parameterized groups are valid with an explicit individually addressable setting-name to case/default/outcome/assertion mapping. Keep owner/reader-specific cases separate where the same setting has different defaults or invalid-value diagnostics. Resolve referenced parser bodies rather than treating their names as capability outcomes.

Identifies actual native logging,SDK/agent/provider/bridge ownership and startup reachability. Uses one supported owner per record,retains original sinks and does not infer a working pipeline from environment variables alone.

Preserves record semantics:actual WARN mapping,source occurrence versus observed time,bounded useful bodies and supported structured values. Does not invent mandatory EventName,exception payloads or unsupported SDK capabilities. Numeric severity band names do not prescribe SeverityText casing. Derive exact text from the selected bridge/source mapping; do not require uppercase WARN/INFO/ERROR when that bridge emits lowercase warn/info/error. Distinguish optional absent text with a permitted short-name substitution from replacing a present source value; audit expectations must match verified or explicitly unverified capability.

Requires or proves canonical log TraceId and SpanId joins to exact real SDK spans,with parentage and source-backed Resource identity. Ordinary attributes,nonempty IDs,shared TraceId or stdout correlation alone are insufficient. Derive the expected SpanId from the actual bridge/API-selected context, including supported caller-side capture when used. A framework INTERNAL child is valid with the correct verified request ancestry; an unsupported SERVER-only expectation is not. Do not remove legitimate layer spans or overwrite valid context solely to satisfy an invented topology. For cross-process correlation, assess the actual peer carrier and installed propagator capability before assigning a logger/context repair. Preserve emitted flags and runtime constraints; report an unsupported peer feature honestly rather than stripping flags, manually copying IDs or silently raising the runtime floor. A supported-stack positive workflow still requires its real end-to-end join. Rejection of a valid peer carrier remains a propagator dependency conformance gap; do not relabel it optional covered behavior or treat an unsupported report as a successful join.

Addresses the actual owned executor/goroutine/callback path and concurrent left/right request pairing. Reuses verified Java/Node propagation;identifies or repairs missing Go request-context and Python executor propagation. Separate sync and async probes cannot prove the same worker-to-real-span path. Scope error/cancellation controls to existing owned behavior or clearly labeled supported SDK probes. Do not require a new business cancellation feature on an app with no such path; ending a span or detaching context cannot be counted as canceling scheduled work. Preserve all controls already required by the bound contract, executing them or retaining them as not proven. For bound restoration controls, a throw caught inside the same context scope does not prove cleanup after escape. Check exact span context on each reused bound callback record, and schedule/assert the subsequent callback after actual cancellation under its own context; counts or a synchronous outside log alone cannot close those controls.
Distinguishes legitimate outside-span/unsampled context from broken wiring. No stale request IDs on startup logs,no fabricated spans/forced sampling,and explicit uncertainty for unexecuted cases.

Applies source-backed privacy and exception scope without introducing raw request IDs,unbounded errors or unsupported alias requirements. Bounded left/right categories are permitted;ordinary native messages do not require instrumentation-only exception events. When a selected privacy probe exposes framework/access/error renderer content captured by the path, do not defer it merely as dependency-owned. Preserve permitted diagnostic category, effective level, sinks and application behavior while removing policy-forbidden values at the policy-selected boundary; blanket suppression is not redaction. Inspect a supported native hook or explicitly leave a genuinely unsupported boundary unresolved, then rerun the actual failing probe in native and OTLP output. A retained native parser category does not satisfy exported-category preservation when the OTLP body was replaced by a generic redaction label. Assess each selected output boundary independently and retain genuinely inapplicable inputs with source evidence instead of adding capture. For a policy requiring pre-capture protection, an SDK onEmit sanitizer cannot close native-console/original-argument capture. Assess supported Express error middleware and any downstream/default re-rendering, preserving category, HTTP status/headers and the applicable response contract, or retain the exact unresolved boundary. Reconcile a framework traceback observed during opt-out/another-profile tests with the normal enabled bridge; replay the same source-backed failing request at the selected boundary before closing privacy. Successful-request OTLP logs cannot close that error-rendering path. Inspect all framework records captured by the selected bridge, not only a fixed-message/application-logger allowlist; separately routed SDK diagnostics retain their own boundary. A policy violation in framework/container records captured by the newly added or selected log pipeline is part of that authorized logging baseline, including a direct invocation without an audit. Do not defer a supported logging-only sanitizer as new custom business instrumentation requiring another audit; inspect and repair the selected boundary, preserve immutable existing audit IDs and explicit exclusions, and rerun the failing probe. Evidence of a genuinely unsupported hook can retain the gap.

Assesses applicable log/Body limits and construction costs against actual defaults and selected requirements. Where the selected implementation and configuration are available, resolve and report effective log attribute count/value limits or unlimited behavior, precedence and source evidence. Follow forwarding into the active provider and actual normalization/enforcement for the selected supported value shapes; do not leave source-resolvable generic fallback or recursion as unverified. Unsupported shapes remain explicit rather than invented. Distinguish byte arrays from strings, recursive array/map value limits from top-level count, and implemented depth counting/replacement from unsupported depth capability. Resolve the record-to-normalizer delegation and per-record diagnostic emission paths when available; an option declaration or successful truncation does not establish these facts. A future runtime boundary test cannot replace accessible configuration facts. Keep those facts distinct from unexecuted behavior; genuinely missing source/configuration may remain explicitly unverified with its concrete resolution check. No span-limit substitution,mandatory arbitrary new cap,provider replacement or expensive guard on every cheap fixed-message call. Resolve the active NodeSDK-to-LoggerProvider construction and installed module files before leaving effective defaults/configuration unknown. A guessed missing file or a public LoggerProvider option does not establish NodeSDK support; source-proven defaults may suffice without new overrides, separate from unexecuted limit-boundary proof. Classify diagnostic causes before counting: the common ceiling concerns messages for truncation/discard/replacement due to limits. An invalid-key or uniqueness-validation message is not automatically another limit diagnostic; do not infer a violation solely from those unrelated messages co-occurring. Resolve the actual supported limit-diagnostic paths and any shared/per-cause guard without requiring application suppression of unrelated diagnostics. A configuration-validation warning about a limit option, without a limit-induced record-data change, is not a per-record truncation/drop diagnostic violation. Distinguish that countercase before assigning a conformance gap; preserve independent diagnostic policies. Before applying the limit-caused diagnostic ceiling, establish that the branch actually truncates, discards or replaces record data because of that limit. A configuration/option warning emitted inside normalization but returning the value unchanged is not evidence of such a change. Keep source-known once-guard and no-emission facts distinct from unexecuted cadence proof.

Keeps delivery evidence accurate:batch/lifecycle owner,effective deadlines,healthy one-per-call receipts versus transport retries,and attempted/accepted/rejected/dropped/unknown distinctions. Does not promote enqueue,HTTP success or a source default into receiver proof. Completed negative OTLP responses must be classified separately from an unacknowledged stall. Record observed retry exhaustion and retain acceptance uncertainty where evidence or the protocol leaves it unresolved, including response-size failures. For a valid partial response with N known records and R rejected, explicitly account for N-R acknowledged accepted and R rejected, without equating either with backend persistence or received copies; populated partial success must not be retried, including warning-only zero rejection. Unknown accepted counts are legitimate for a completed negative response when protocol/evidence does not resolve them; do not require an invented zero. Assess known response failure and terminal retry decisions across canonical reports and raw/source-bound evidence. A null count alone does not prove that a response was misclassified as pending. For multi-batch partial/warning-only trials, reconcile each request/response N/R before summing accepted/rejected totals; the canonical report must expose per-outcome counts and raw links, not only received copies or a prose pass. A shared scenario covering completed negative responses or stalls must not inherit an unqualified otlp_accepted visibility from another successful subtrial; split observations or use supported visibility with explicit per-outcome evidence. Audit plans these assertions; runtime claims require their execution. Explicitly preserve valid N-R/R partial-success and warning-only N/0 acceptance assertions in the saved handoff. Assess selected-transport request/response size clauses and parsing after decompression, including SDK-client response-bound/non-retryable oversize behavior and receiver-owned limits. Recommended64MiB request/4MiB response values are not mandatory app overrides; missing public configuration is not proof of missing built-in limits. Source-proven SDK/receiver limits or unsupported/unverified capability are valid dispositions, without custom app parsers or forced upgrades. Audit plans the concrete controls; runtime claims require applicable execution or honest missing capability/proof. Preserve the conforming HTTP full-success control: HTTP200 with the selected response encoding and partial_success unset acknowledges all N transmitted records and zero rejected, independently of persistence. A generic200 with an invalid/unrelated body is insufficient. Unexecuted selected partial/warning controls still retain concrete future N-R/R and N/0 no-retry assertions, not merely a Not tested label. A server receipt saying it wrote503 is not proof the SDK observed a completed503: match each batch to the actual client terminal result/deadline and keep server intent separate from timeout. Owned-receiver-only trials may honestly use not_explorer_visible; a shared row without one stronger proven visibility retains not_proven with the matching status and per-outcome evidence, preserving audit IDs. Keep configured/effective timeouts distinct from measured export/caller durations. Whole-process or shutdown elapsed time alone cannot prove each batch deadline; retain that duration claim unproven or use a supported timing probe at its actual scope. Use per-batch/attempt client and receiver evidence to separate timed-out requests from completed503 responses before aggregation; a server-only status cannot classify all received records as client-completed failures. Direct instrumentation without an audit still carries its own concrete full/partial/warning acceptance assertions. Future partial-success acceptance must explicitly assert no retry for populated partial success with positive R as well as for warning-only R=0. A warning-only no-retry assertion does not supply the positive-rejection assertion; preserve both alongside their separate count controls. Derive N from each decoded request and check acknowledgement arithmetic per trial: a one-record success cannot report two accepted because another fixture sent two. When explicitly bound, direct Export, BatchProcessor timing, caller-triggered cancellation and persistent immediate-failure exhaustion retain separate assertions; 503 followed by200 proves recovery, not exhaustion. Unproven/mixed negative or stalled rows cannot retain unqualified otlp_accepted visibility from another subtrial. Build batch/attempt observations before trial totals and reconcile raw client/receiver results on readback. A combined503/timeout label cannot collapse batches with different known client terminal outcomes; unresolved batch matching must stay explicit. Read concrete constructor/option proposals against the retained public declaration and selected SDK construction. For a verified one-options-object BatchLogRecordProcessor API, exporter and selected tuning fields belong in that same object; an incompatible exporter, options positional call fails even in a plan. Preserve a different actually verified installed signature; no forced SDK upgrade or version pin. Validate the actual proposed configuration value representation against the selected parser/type, not only a unit label or option name. A rejected value falling back to a default does not establish the proposed bound. For an existing/selected repeated-stop policy, retain same-process delivery while final logging/provider drain is active and the corresponding event-order assertions; separate single stops or requests after exit cannot establish that conjunction. Assess deliberate forced exit under its actual policy. Resolve an elapsed retry setting from the full loop, including the selected backoff/throttle wait and next attempt. An after-failure or retry-eligibility check is not automatically a strict whole-export ceiling; preserve an actual earlier enclosing cancellation deadline and any source-visible overshoot condition. If final-record receipt is part of the selected claim, its own acceptance must cover expected Resource and associated context, including a legitimate absent-context outcome, along with body/count/time. Do not borrow those assertions from a different earlier record. Reconcile selected simple/batch processor Export synchronization at the actual invocation/completion boundary; distinguish exporter-internal request concurrency and do not demand duplicate app locking when SDK behavior covers it. Distinguish raw serialized timeout assignments from human-readable quantities. For protocol non-retry classification proof, use a retry-capable policy and a positive retryable-response control under that policy; disabled retries, a one-attempt cap or an already exhausted budget cannot establish response classification. Preserve operator policy and separate a scoped SDK control from application proof when necessary.

Checks applicable diagnostic routing and configured-signal isolation. Source review or healthy traffic does not establish an outage test;unexecuted fault/optional SDK cases remain explicitly unproven instead of fabricated passes. Require the actual application bootstrap and its real trace/metric receipts under a logs-only outage; an isolated log-only provider and counting diagnostic logger cannot prove this. Repeated stop acceptance follows the chosen application policy during the active drain, separating deliberate forced exit from graceful final-record receipt. An approved live destination guard does not by itself block all application fault tests: assess an isolated process-local transport seam that preserves the real SDK/bootstrap and call sites, actual log failure responses and healthy other-signal receipts. Keep app_test scope honest, restore mocks, preserve production guards and the shared receiver, and retain concrete limitations if no safe supported seam is available.

Uses fresh source/command/dependency-bound evidence with actual outcome counts and retained failures. Honors required project runtime and configured local endpoints. A copied old receipt,stale source or zero exit without execution cannot establish current verification. Resolve saved local execution-evidence references to existing retained artifacts. Report trace_ids from that specific scenario operation/receipt or leave them empty when unproven; copying the first IDs from a different request into every row is inaccurate even when the source trial passed. Retain distinct trial storage on the actual filesystem: case-only names may refer to one overwritten file. Check each retained result input/case identity against the claimed trial; two case aliases cannot establish separate true/TRUE controls.

Preserves application routes,behavior,operator identity and original sinks;keeps local logs local and makes no unrequested SDK upgrades,cloud configuration or unrelated business instrumentation. Supported defaults and upstream library duties are not automatically missing application code. Treat effective resource-only service.name as operator identity when OTEL_SERVICE_NAME is absent. New Make/shell/CLI/image/JVM fallbacks must not replace it or discard other resource attributes. Distinguish an explicit supported service-name override from a fallback; use SDK parsing/actual merge behavior, not a custom resource parser. Audit plans the normal-launcher acceptance check; implementation/verification proves applicable resource-only, explicit-override and absent-identity cases. A helper-only pass cannot establish the normal launcher preserves identity. When service.version or another resource field is explicitly promised, require its source-backed expected value and preservation assertion at the declared boundary; name/environment-only checks do not close it. Genuinely unavailable/unpromised optional version metadata remains absent, not invented. Resource-only and absent-identity controls must account for an active .env/profile reloading OTEL_SERVICE_NAME; merely unsetting the parent process or exercising a helper cannot establish those normal-launcher cases. Use isolated configuration copies and preserve operator settings.

Reconciles applicable official logging guidance by requirement strength,owner,capability and proof boundary in the normal report. Separates normative OTel requirements,recommendations,optional/Development features and local policy;does not claim full coverage with unmapped applicable obligations. The applicable transport-size clauses must have explicit owner/capability/disposition entries in the canonical matrix, including HTTP client response parsing limits after decompression when HTTP is selected; a generic buffering or Body-limit entry cannot substitute. Preserve the distinction between the server SHOULD reducing an oversized partial response without changing semantics when possible/practical and the MAY permission to trim optional diagnostics; do not make that optional mechanism mandatory. When condensing a source paragraph, retain each distinct condition, action, requirement strength and disposition. A later mandatory failure fallback or topic citation cannot cover an omitted earlier recommendation/permission. Check all grouped source clauses individually, including the conditional semantics-preserving SHOULD and the separate optional diagnostic-trimming MAY. Preserve applicability qualifiers and cross-cutting transport-limit configurability SHOULD. A clearly scoped shared matrix row referenced by affected surfaces can carry that common clause; do not require duplicate prose in every row, and do not infer transport coverage from an unrelated generic SDK-configuration row. Semantics-preserving reduction retains when possible and practical. Exact clause bindings are a valid alternative to repeating source prose: a canonical row may reference a precisely bounded retained source excerpt (file/hash and lines or addressable snippet) with explicit owner/disposition. Instrumentation/verification may identify exact immutable-audit evidence rows for unchanged normative clauses, but must refresh installed capability and runtime outcomes. Follow those explicit references before judging omission; a generic URL or See audit without specific row/clauses is insufficient, and prior runtime success cannot be inherited. A source excerpt about OTLP exporter configuration settings alone does not bind the separate OTLP protocol size/decompression/oversize/reduction clauses. Resolve those clauses or explicitly mark each unverified with its owner and conditional test; a generic newer-clauses disclaimer is not a clause disposition. Refresh each current capability/result disposition after installation and probes while preserving immutable audit source bindings. A copied Not installed/executed baseline is not a current capability result, and unrelated runtime/worker receipts do not prove a tested exporter limit. Common attribute-limit diagnostics are MAY, but when emitted for truncation/discard/replacement MUST be at most once per affected record; Logs SDK discard diagnostics separately have SHOULD emission and the same per-record ceiling. Successful truncation does not establish diagnostic cadence. Inspect actual messages per record and preserve an observed upstream limitation rather than blanket SDK-default coverage, application suppression, internal replacement or a forced upgrade. Read concrete repair mechanisms back against retained public constructor/options/units and the actual runner's CLI/environment precedence. A source-contradicted call or launch profile is not a valid executable proposal; an unresolved mechanism can remain unverified with its future check. This is compatibility/evidence consistency, not an extra normative OTel implementation requirement. Carrying unchanged normative bindings by exact immutable audit evidence-row references, with current capability/receipts separately annotated, is valid and avoids lossy re-summarization. Inspect executed capability results before retaining a Source only/future label; source-bound runtime limitations must be reconciled honestly. Derive concrete framework hooks, constructor/options, deadlines, limits and lifecycle mechanisms from this service, its installed implementation and selected policy. Do not impose a fixed recipe, numeric tuning or framework from a skill example on another supported stack; source-proven adequate defaults and another supported repair remain valid. Follow applicable normative imports from primary sections, including common configuration types referenced by SDK environment configuration. Classify supported-source/SDK ownership and capability for numeric parsing/ranges, duration/timeout representation and negative handling, timeout-zero semantics, enum behavior and environment-to-code equivalence. Retain normative strengths and compatibility qualifications, and distinguish standard serialized settings from native typed API values. Unsupported/unverified SDK capability is not an application parser repair. Assess fractional standard serialized numeric/duration/timeout input independently of negative, zero, malformed and overflow/range input. Source acceptance of a fraction cannot silently satisfy an integer-millisecond contract; distinguish native typed API freedom and retain the applicable compatibility qualifications. Assess real enum case/extension/no-op branches and environment-to-code equivalence separately from Boolean controls, with source-resolved capability or concrete conditional future assertions. A retained normative binding does not establish that its mapped controls exercise each distinct condition, input branch, field or promised operation. Unexecuted clauses need applicable concrete conditional acceptance or an exact missing capability-resolution step, not unrelated passing/planned scenarios. Separate public API documentation from implemented enforcement: trace selected capabilities through delegation to the actual check and where a deadline is created, propagated and consumed relative to retries. Retain source/comment contradictions with SDK ownership; a documented guarantee alone cannot establish actual capability. Permitted focused public-boundary probes retain their scoped result rather than app-runtime credit. Normative bindings must resolve the retained primary-source clauses; citing nearby local-guide lines or an SDK comment is not independent upstream evidence. A required-controls inventory or equivalent complete enumeration must retain each owning telemetry item and its promised fields, without converting a candidate scenario reference into acceptance/proof. Keep a source capability worklist through unresolved parser/normalizer/diagnostic/retry delegates. A not-yet-installed proposed SDK or Not-run runtime label does not make its retained source behavior unknown. Resolve each applicable configuration input branch to actual effective/fallback/warning behavior, upstream disposition and concrete conditional acceptance; a generic future group or unrelated Boolean scenario is insufficient. Reconcile selected built-in processor Export synchronization and actual default factories as applicable source clauses/capabilities. For supported SDK-disabled configuration, distinguish no-op SDK signals from unaffected configured propagation and trace actual startup branches. For extension/private enablement flags, establish their contract/applicability and actual defaults/empty/unset behavior before applying standard SDK type rules; do not label a documented extension default an app violation without that basis. Follow configuration dataflow to the final effective consumer, including actual sentinel values, outer defaults, conversion-error fallback and transitively consumed settings. A primitive parser, constant name or unexecuted runtime label cannot substitute for accessible implementation resolution. Allocate concrete conditional controls for each resolved branch and preserve genuine checked capability boundaries. Reconcile each source-derived consumed setting against its applicable normative input conditions, strengths and compatibility qualifications, actual effective behavior and concrete conditional acceptance. Preserve source-bound out-of-path applicability rather than requiring unused declarations or optional features. Do not award completeness to a future-only instruction to construct this inventory when the selected implementation is accessible. Retain source-resolved mechanism facts separately from runtime status; Not run cannot substitute for an accessible consuming check. Configuration helper results do not establish normal-launcher behavior.
